# Inventory Framework

> A versatile and extensible framework for creating inventories.

- [Inventory Framework](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/index.md): Inventory Framework
- [Live demos](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/live-demos/index.md): Basic

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/docs/introduction.md): Inventory Framework draws inspiration from games like Minecraft, Dark Souls, Witcher 3, Diablo II, Path of Exile, Backpack Battles, DayZ, and Escape from Tarkov.
- [Getting Started](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/docs/getting-started.md): The best way to get started is by exploring the demos and examples.
- [Architecture Overview](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/docs/architecture-overview.md): The framework follows a data-driven, event-based architecture. It keeps the data, logic and UI separate.
- [Troubleshooting](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/docs/troubleshooting.md): Join the Discord server for additional support from the developer and the community.
- [Roadmap](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/docs/roadmap.md): Add support for UGUI
- [v1 Docs](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/docs/v1-docs.md): The old website was moved here

## Core API

- [Bag 🚧](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/core-api/bag.md): Bag is the abstract base class for all inventory containers. It defines the common contract for storing, validating, and manipulating Item instances. The base implementation intentionally does very little — most methods return Fail or Success by default.
- [ListBag 🚧](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/core-api/listbag.md)
- [SetBag 🚧](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/core-api/setbag.md)
- [GridBag 🚧](https://gamedevsimplified.github.io/docs/core-api/gridbag.md)
